risks.risk: Energy consumption and GHG emissions from manufacturing

risks.note: Flagged in the BRSR material-issues table as both Risk and Opportunity — non-compliance may result in fines, legal penalties and litigation, adversely affecting both financial performance and brand reputation; mitigated through evaluation of processes and assessment to ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

Flagged in the BRSR material-issues table as both Risk and Opportunity — ethical business practices and transparency foster stakeholder trust and promote ethical decision-making at all organisational levels.

100% of the entity's turnover comes from the manufacture and sale of automotive components, tying the business entirely to the automotive cycle; within that, Electrical & Lighting auto parts (41.41%) and Polymer auto parts (34.83%) account for the bulk of turnover, so product-line concentration compounds the sector concentration.

Exports contribute only 3.8% of the entity's total turnover on the standalone reporting boundary, leaving the listed entity heavily dependent on domestic demand even though it serves both domestic and international OEMs and an aftermarket presence in over 27 countries.
risks.risk: Limited export diversification at the listed-entity level

risks.note: Turnover rate for permanent employees rose to 17.46% in FY 2026 from 16.60% in FY 2025 and 15% in FY 2024, with female permanent-employee attrition higher at 22.57% — a structural talent-retention risk as mobility technology capabilities become scarcer.

The Group implemented a Voluntary Separation Scheme for permanent workmen across various manufacturing facilities to streamline the workforce and optimise operating costs; 432 applications were received, 411 accepted, and the scheme concluded on January 16, 2026 — execution of such cost actions carries near-term profitability and industrial-relations implications.
risks.risk: Workforce restructuring and labour relations across manufacturing facilities
